# CafeGroup Inc

> > Creative technology group specializing in 3DCG production, xR/VR development, AI engineering, and venture capital investment in the entertainment and technology sectors.

CafeGroup operates multiple specialized divisions including ModelingCafe, CELAVIE, AnimationCafe, CAFE VFX, and Cafe Engineering, delivering high-end CG animation, character modeling, VFX, and real-time rendering for games, anime, commercials, and music videos. The company also maintains an active venture portfolio supporting startups in creative technology.

## Key Topics

- 3DCG production and character modeling
- xR (AR/VR) technology development
- Generative AI and machine learning
- Unity and Unreal Engine development
- Anime production and CG animation
- Game cinematics and character rigging
- VFX and visual effects
- Venture capital investment
- ModelingCafe, CELAVIE, AnimationCafe, CAFE VFX divisions
- Key personnel: Kenichi Nishida, Mototsugu Endo, Koichi Kishimoto
- Major clients: Square Enix, Konami, Cygames, SUNRISE, NHK
- Portfolio projects: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, SILENT HILL, GRANBLUE FANTASY: Relink, Gundam SEED FREEDOM

## Company Overview

- [CafeGroup Inc Homepage](https://cafegroup.net/ja): Creative group specializing in 3DCG, xR tech & startup investment
- [Works Portfolio](https://cafegroup.net/works): Portfolio showcasing animation, VFX, 3D modeling & game development projects
- [Venture Partners](https://cafegroup.net/venture-partners): Venture capital portfolio including Aww, imma, and LASTMILE WORKS

## Core Divisions

- [AnimationCafe](https://cafegroup.net/animationcafe): Animation studio division for CG animation, game cinematics & commercials
- [Cafe Engineering](https://cafegroup.net/cafe-engineering): Engineering division for Unity, Unreal Engine, AR/VR & generative AI dev

## Game Development Projects

- [FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH](https://cafegroup.net/works/2178): Animation work for Square Enix's Final Fantasy VII Rebirth game
- [GRANBLUE FANTASY: Relink](https://cafegroup.net/works/2137): ModelingCafe's character & background work for Cygames' Granblue Fantasy Relink
- [SILENT HILL: The Short Message](https://cafegroup.net/works/2075): Character modeling, rigging & animation for Konami's Silent Hill game

## Anime & Film Production

- [MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED FREEDOM](https://cafegroup.net/works/2106): CELAVIE's CG production & setup work for SUNRISE's Gundam film (2024)
- [機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM (Japanese)](https://cafegroup.net/ja/works/2106): CELAVIE's CG & setup collaboration for Gundam SEED Freedom (Japanese)
- [KAMIERABI GOD.app](https://cafegroup.net/works/2149): CELAVIE's anime work for Fuji TV's +Ultra: 3D modeling & battle scenes
- [Ochibisan](https://cafegroup.net/works/2109): CELAVIE animation work for NHK's Ochibisan episode 18 by Moyoco Anno
